_note: Programmes, events, competitions and communities, by field, stage and nation. CURATED DEMO: these are real organisers and programme types, but there are NO specific dates here, only the months a programme typically opens (open_months) or 'rolling' for year-round ones. Links go to the organiser's homepage, not a deep link. Organisers change eligibility, names and dates every year: check the organiser before relying on any entry. Live feeds (employer careers pages, event listings) are planned adapters, not connected.
